name: baseUrl
label: Instance URL
help: The address you open Bines OS at, e.g. https://crm.example.com (with or without /api/v1).

name: apiToken
label: API token
help: A personal API token (bos_pat_…) from Bines OS → profile menu → API tokens. Give it the scopes your scenarios need: boards:read, items:write, updates:write, webhooks (instant triggers), users:read, boards:write (groups), agents:run (AI agents).
